info.name: Ahmad Adlouni
info.position: Senior Software Engineer at Siren Analytics

paragraphs: 👋 Hi! I'm a **Senior Software Engineer** at [Siren Analytics](https://sirenanalytics.com) with 7+ years of experience building responsive, accessible and scalable web applications for government, enterprise and digital-service platforms.

I specialise in **Angular, TypeScript and frontend architecture**, with deep experience in dynamic multi-step forms, configurable form-builder tools, dashboards, workflow interfaces and API integration. 💻

I've delivered bilingual Arabic/English (RTL) public-sector portals integrated with national government systems, offline-capable Progressive Web Apps for field data collection, and secure frontends hardened against penetration-test findings. 🚀
I'm comfortable across the full delivery lifecycle: requirements, prototyping, development, UAT, deployment, documentation, training and post-launch support. 📚
I build with AI coding tools like **Claude Code**: I own the architecture, specs, code review and tests, and let AI speed up the implementation. 🤖
about.signOff: Welcome to my portfolio, where code meets creativity! ✨

experience.summary: Lead frontend development for public-sector platforms and government service-delivery systems in Jordan and Lebanon, working with backend, QA, design and business-analysis teams. Promoted to Senior Software Engineer in November 2024.
highlights: **MoDEE–EMRC e-Licensing Portal (Jordan):** dozens of bilingual (Arabic/English) licensing and renewal services, with multi-step forms validated in real time against national registries through the Government Service Bus.

**DAEM National Social Assistance Platform (Lebanon):** main frontend developer across four Angular apps, including an offline-capable field-survey PWA and a citizen portal with QR and PDF417 ID-card scanning.
Led **Form Studio**, a drag-and-drop form builder library shared across the DAEM apps, and the UI/UX revamp of three portals under one shared theme.
**PAX Foundation Project Management System:** applicant and back-office portals with phased review workflows, map-based project search and an AI assistant chat.
Remediated penetration-test findings (token storage, XSS, exposed file access) and added reCAPTCHA and session auto-logout.

experience.position: Software Engineer, Senior UI & Front-End Engineer
experience.summary: Owned the complete software development life cycle for the VestaPay product, from analysis to testing, using Java, GWT, Spring Boot and Oracle Database.
highlights: Designed the MPR project in Figma as Senior UI and Front-End Engineer and led its transition from GWT to Angular 15, NgRx and Spring Boot.
Built dashboards, data tables and reusable UI components, and maintained the VSC dashboard with integrated live chat.
Developed Dialogflow CX chatbots on the Twilio Conversations API, extended with external APIs and webhooks.
Implemented a Node.js/Express server with JWT authentication and HTTPS.

experience.position: Front-End Web Development and Database Instructor
experience.summary: Taught Front-End Web Development and MySQL database management to Palestinian university students and recent graduates.
highlights: Curriculum: HTML, CSS layout, JavaScript and the DOM, Angular (routing, HttpClient, services) and MySQL.

experience.summary: Built full-stack web applications and Android apps published on Google Play (see Projects below).
highlights: Web apps with Angular, PHP Slim and MySQL / SQL Server, including admin dashboards, PWAs and RESTful APIs.
Integrated third-party APIs such as OnlineSim.io.

experience.summary: Built interfaces and reusable components for the Bluering Retail platform with Angular 5, Bootstrap 4, HTML5 and CSS3.
highlights: Implemented design system standards, reusable UI modules and responsive layouts.
Improved navigation flows, form validation, loading performance and cross-browser compatibility.

experience.summary: Contributed to a single-page application built with AngularJS, C# / ASP.NET Web APIs and Microsoft SQL Server stored procedures.
Worked on the "ID Card Reader" project, from requirements and UML design to a Symfony web dashboard.
highlights: Built the dashboard (Symfony MVC, Doctrine ORM, MySQL) with Google OAuth sign-in.
Created RESTful APIs for the companion Android app.

description: A bilingual (Arabic/English, right-to-left first) website and clinic management platform for a clinical dietitian: a public site where patients learn about her services, and a staff workspace for running the clinic day to day.
techDescription: Dietitian workspace: patient directory and files, clinical record and medical history, clinical calculators, and a meal-plan builder with a food library, plan revisions, and meal options with pick rules.

Scheduling: a Today view and reception queue, a calendar where visits are dragged to reschedule or booked by clicking an empty slot, availability search, holidays and closures, and a follow-up tracker for patients whose plans are ending.
Messaging: bilingual WhatsApp reminder and follow-up templates that respect patients who opted out.
Administration: services, opening hours, and staff accounts with roles (owner, practitioner, reception), enforced in Firestore Security Rules and Cloud Functions rather than only in the UI.

Built with Angular 19, Angular Material, Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions) and ngx-translate; tested with Security Rules tests, Cloud Functions integration tests and Playwright end-to-end tests against the Firebase emulators.
Built with Claude Code from a product spec I wrote, with every change reviewed and covered by automated tests.

description: A reusable, configurable drag-and-drop form builder for designing dynamic multi-step forms and workflows (DAEM, Siren Analytics), packaged as a standalone library (v1.0) and shared across the WFPS portal, an offline-capable field-survey PWA and the citizen registration portal.
techDescription: Builder: drag-and-drop and click-to-add palette, grid layouts, repeatable sections, steppers with step reordering, a visual conditional-logic builder, validation rules, a validation dependency graph, and JSON and consistency-rule code editors (CodeMirror).

Workflow: draft, publish and archive layout versions per survey type, clone layouts across survey types, export/import configurations between environments, permission-gated actions and a guided product tour.

Runtime: a reusable application renderer with responsive and RTL/LTR preview, lookup data sources, file uploads, camera and barcode scanner fields, resumable linear steppers and a read-only document view of submitted applications.

Extensible through runtime APIs for custom fields, property panels, event handlers and consistency rules; includes an AI form-assistant panel whose responses are validated against a schema before being applied.
Built with Angular, TypeScript, Angular Formly, RxJS and SCSS, with Karma/Jasmine tests and bilingual (Arabic/English) user and developer documentation.

description: The project aims to spread knowledge among all the employees at all levels of the institution's sectors and departments, in order to raise the learning curve, spread the supportive institutional culture in a practical and systematic way, maximize the use of the knowledge and expertise in the organization which is a major element in promoting proactive knowledge.
The application is available in English and Arabic versions.
techDescription: Responsible for creating efficient design and developing User Interaction screens using HTML, CSS3, Bootstrap and Angular 8.
Organizing and structuring the Angular app into modules in addition to creating custom reusable components.
Implemented HTTP requests using RxJS Observable library to handle multiple values over time.
Implemented RESTful APIs in Entity Framework Core 2.0 and Microsoft SQL Server, securing the APIs with JWT and used JSON for data exchange between the client side and the server side.
details.lesson: The biggest codebase I'd worked on at that point (232 commits over six months): organising an Angular app into modules and reusable components, working with RxJS, building bilingual English/Arabic screens and securing a .NET Core API with JWT.

description: A website that displays the wholesale prices of various mobile phones in Lebanon.
techDescription: Developed in PHP using the Slim Framework, with Progressive Web App (PWA) capabilities.
details.lesson: A quick build that introduced me to Progressive Web Apps: making a server-rendered PHP site installable like an app.

description: A Web Application that allows people to buy virtual numbers from various countries (Russia, Germany, etc...) to use it in different services, such as: WhatsApp, Facebook, Viber, etc...
The web application consists of a dashboard that is used by admin users and a PWA (Progressive Web Application) application that is used by normal users.
techDescription: It is developed using Angular, PHP Slim micro-framework (RESTful APIs / JWT) and MySQL.
Integrated Online-Sim APIs for purchasing virtual numbers for different social networks platforms and used Firebase Cloud Messaging for sending push notifications.
details.lesson: Shipping a real product end to end: an Angular PWA for users and a dashboard for admins on top of my own JWT-secured PHP API, plus a third-party provider integration (Online-Sim) and push notifications with Firebase Cloud Messaging.

description: An Android application lets you view and save WhatsApp photo images and video statuses of your friends. It also enables you to share them directly from the app with your friends.
techDescription: Used Java programming language for the implementation and followed the MVP (Model-View-Presenter) pattern.
Used Picasso library for displaying images and video thumbnails.
details.lesson: Taught me to structure an Android app with the MVP pattern and to handle media efficiently, loading image and video thumbnails with Picasso.

description: A website that displays deals from different online stores such as AliExpress.
techDescription: Responsible for implementing the UI interfaces and reusable components for the admin dashboard and the store in Angular.
Responsible for implementing RESTful APIs using PHP Slim micro-framework and MySQL.
details.lesson: Building both sides of a product myself: an Angular store and admin dashboard on top of a PHP Slim REST API and MySQL database I designed.

description: An android application that handles all the operations for sending dollars and days to touch and alfa mobile numbers from the MMService application.
techDescription: Worked on implementing the required listeners for reading and processing incoming messages and USSD messages.
Worked on the implementation for sending messages from both Sim 1 and 2 programmatically using the SmsManager and running USSD codes.
Used SQLite and Firebase Cloud Firestore for saving and reading data.
details.lesson: Working close to the Android platform: listening for incoming SMS and USSD responses, sending from two SIM cards and keeping data in sync between SQLite and Firestore.

description: Led a small team which consists of two software developers.
techDescription: Responsible for the implementation of the server-side changes using Flask micro-framework with the Flask-RESTX extension for building REST APIs and PostgreSQL relational database.
Worked on the implementation of some client-side components using React and Bootstrap.
details.lesson: My first time leading other developers: splitting work between two teammates while building REST APIs with Flask-RESTX and PostgreSQL, and picking up React along the way.

description: An android application that lets you search for a domain name to check its availability and its price.
techDescription: Worked on the design and implementation of the user interfaces.
Worked on the integration of GoDaddy APIs and consuming them with Retrofit REST client.
details.lesson: Learning to consume a third-party REST API properly, with Retrofit and GoDaddy's domains API, and designing an app's screens myself.

description: An Android application that lets you count your prayers on your phone.
techDescription: Developed in Java.
details.lesson: A small idea taken all the way from an empty Android project to a published Google Play release.
